enrichment method: We collected the soluble fraction (i.e., the supernatant) and the chromatin fraction (i.e., pellets suspended in NETN without EDTA and then sonicated and treated with turbonuclease) for tandem affinity purification.
fractionation method: the bound proteins were resolved by sodium dodecyl sulfate–polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis (SDS-PAGE) and analyzed by mass spectrometry.
labeling: the bound proteins were resolved by sodium dodecyl sulfate–polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis (SDS-PAGE) and analyzed by mass spectrometry.
reduction reagent: Cells were lysed in NETN buffer (20 mM Tris-HCl [pH 8.0], 1 mM EDTA, 100 mM NaCl, 0.5% NP-40, and 1 mM DTT, with phosphatase and proteinase inhibitors)
